name: Vajra
source:
Duergar form of Sheeta. Vajra being her codename in beastia.

Sheetas another form, she was actually not of dragon-race but a druergar of beastia, something very similar but different. Is the youngest druergar and only one born after the great war. Is looked down because of her mindset is differs from other duergars and is unable to use the signature ability of duergars dragnam, and generally being lot weaker than other duergars. Sees Radius as companion because of him also being of the "new"-generation of duergars.

[spoiler] Later masters her dragnam which is "Creation" [/spoiler]
